time.closing_policy: At minute 420 stop new spawns and lift boarding; agents already riding or skiing finish a safe route to a base, then exit. Queued agents exit from the lift base. Record actual times until exit.

population.mixed_preference_rule: Freeze up to two personally experienced lifts with smallest mean realized waits at 40% of planned stay; never supplement.

spawning.spawn_location_rule: Choose among physically admissible active lift bases for the assigned skier class/subtype; seeded random. Do not spawn an agent onto an inaccessible summit. Observe every active queue upon spawning.
spawning.departure_rule: Arrival mode: Poisson arrivals in first half; equal-rate Poisson departure selections in second half, uniformly from active skiers not already selected. Selected skiers finish their current committed lap; in base transit exit at next base. No random stay-based exits. Closing overrides queues.

movement.length_source: the sum of segment lengths along the routed polyline, scaled by map coordinates; centerline_length_m is the canonical precomputed value for full edges
movement.route_policy: directed graph shortest feasible base-to-base transit time; use real node/edge connections only
movement.run_choice_policy: random compatible complete descending itinerary from chosen lift, except specialty lappers follow their assigned specialty
movement.turtle_visualization: moving dot markers on polyline at interpolated 3D surface altitude

decision.initial_observation: all active lift queues at spawn
decision.refresh_policy: refresh only at physical lift base visit (before decision at current lift and on committed arrival at chosen lift)
decision.remote_state_visibility: none after spawn unless physically visited
decision.ties: uniform seeded random among equal minimum-cost candidate lifts
decision.commitment: do not reconsider destination until after completion of a downhill itinerary

queues.service_model: Instantaneous individual boarding on fixed capacity-paced service slots; missed empty slots expire.
queues.actual_boarding: S_j(t) <= mu_j, constrained by waiting skiers and operating status
queues.capacity_note: All four lifts board at 600 skiers per hour (one skier every six seconds). Ride times unchanged.

interface.graphics: 2D supplied map and exact planar polylines; absent heightfield is not reconstructed

provenance.class_shares: synthetic assumptions, not measured Vail GPS proportions
provenance.skier_profile_motivation: background literature; do not attribute user's four classes or shares to a source without evidence
provenance.topography: synthetic modeled mountain, not an actual ski area
